papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are usually frozen after deployment, so they do not learn from the cases they solve. papers.title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
papers.summary: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas.
